name: Necromancer: Diabolical stacks only from Necromancer spells (#11122)
contract: Diabolical 704723 reads 'Casting spells now grants you 1 stack of Diabolical' and its buff is 707133. Report #11122 shows a stack granted when summoning a mount. Sense Undead 5502 is SPELLFAMILY_PALADIN (10) with DamageClass NONE and stands in for a mount, a profession or any other non-Necromancer non-triggered cast, as in necromancer-permafrost-class-spells-only-10844. A cast of it must leave 707133 at zero stacks; Blight 500237 is family 29 with no cost, cooldown or global cooldown and must still grant exactly one stack.
